info.title: FSP Career API
info.description: Platform contract. Implemented by the local stateful mock with synthetic data (the frontend development and behavior reference) and by the Rust backend in backend/ (operation coverage tracked in docs/backend-implementation-checklist.md). JSON responses use camelCase. Salary is integer RUB/month before tax. No production authentication, code execution, external provider, or real LLM is implemented.

servers.description: Same origin; development Vite proxy forwards /api to 127.0.0.1:4010.
